AGM.name: Company Meeting
AGM.description: Annual General meeting of shareholders is held once a year, usually after the end of the financial year. Also includes other meeting types such as Extraordinary General Meeting, Special General Meeting, Court Ordered Meeting, and Postal Ballot.

fields.name: meeting_time
fields.description: Local time for Start of Meeting

ANN.name: Announcement
ANN.description: Intent of the company to have Corporate Action which may affect the shareholder's value. The intent may or may not materialise into an event.

ARR.name: Arrangement
ARR.description: A general term referring to complex reorganisation of a company or a group of companies and its capital.

ASSM.name: Assimilation
ASSM.description: A general term referring to complex reorganisation of a company or a group of companies and its capital.

BB.name: Buy Back
BB.description: Buyback events can also be used to transmit Dutch Auction events.

fields.name: buy_back_min_percentage
fields.description: Minimum percentage of the shares outstanding the company will buy back from shareholders.

fields.name: buy_back_max_percentage
fields.description: Maximum percentage of the shares outstanding the company will buy back from shareholders.

fields.name: on_off_flag
fields.description: The mechanism adopted by the company for buying back the shares. Default blank. N - On Market i.e. via the exchange. F - Off Market i.e. some other mechanism other than the exchange.

BBCC.name: BBG Composite Change
BBCC.description: To allow change in Bloomberg's ticker or the mapping of BBG ID to a Security ID.

BBEC.name: BBG Figi Change
BBEC.description: To allow change in Bloomberg's ticker or the mapping of BBG ID to a ISO 4217 exchange code.

fields.name: old_figi
fields.description: Old Bloomberg Exchange ID - Old Figi

fields.name: new_figi
fields.description: New Bloomberg Exchange ID - New Figi

fields.name: old_figi_ticker
fields.description: Old Bloomberg Exchange Ticker - Old Figi Ticker

fields.name: new_figi_ticker
fields.description: New Bloomberg Exchange Ticker - New Figi Ticker

BKRP.name: Bankruptcy
BKRP.description: When a company's net worth goes below the country's stipulated guideline. There could be several stages in the Bankruptcy process. Hence, one sees several announcements over a period of time. The end result of Bankruptcy could be revival, sale, re-organisation, liquidation etc.

fields.name: emergence_date
fields.description: Emergence from Bankruptcy Date currently used in US only.

BON.name: Bonus
BON.description: Issue of FREE securities to the shareholders of the Company by capitalising the reserves of the company. Security being issued can be an instrument other than Equity Share.

fields.name: lapsed_premium
fields.description: If the underlying security has a Bonus issue and company decides ADR shares will not have bonus. The company will sell the share on behalf of ADR holders in the market and return the money to ADR holders. So there is no ratio.

BR.name: Bonus Rights
BR.description: A Bonus issue with tradable rights attached. Effectively, a mixture of Bonus and Rights.

fields.name: sub_exp_time
fields.description: For a specified date, the time at which the event is set to expire.

fields.name: sub_exp_time_zone
fields.description: Time Zone of the Expiry Time.

fields.name: over_subscription
fields.description: A flag to indicate if the shareholders have the option of oversubscribing for the issue.

fields.name: trading_security_id
fields.description: Security ID of the security that may be created for Trading purposes.

CALL.name: Call
CALL.description: Where the issue price of a security in an offer is split in such a way that the shareholders have to pay the issue price in installments. Until the full issue price is received by the company the security remains as Partly Paid. A call is a demand to pay an installment.

fields.name: call_number
fields.description: Number of the call which the company has made on the security. For example: 1st Call, 2nd Call, 3rd Call

CAPRD.name: Capital Reduction
CAPRD.description: Write off of existing Equity Capital of a company by either reducing the par value and/or by cancelling a certain number of shares or capital. If a cash payment is involved then it is described as Return of Capital.

CLSAC.name: Class Action
CLSAC.description: Holders of security(ies) of a company combine to file a suit for damages from the company.

fields.name: court_id
fields.description: Unique ID of the Court with which the complaint has been filed

fields.name: case_number
fields.description: Court assigned number of the case

fields.name: allegations
fields.description: Reasons for which the claimants are initiating a class action. For example: Fraud, Misrepresentation, non-disclosure, insider trading etc.

fields.name: eligible_securities
fields.description: Securities eligible to participate in the action

fields.name: investor_class
fields.description: Investor class that can participate in the action

fields.name: on_behalf_of
fields.description: The Class Action is on behalf of buyer or seller

CONSD.name: Consolidation
CONSD.description: Increase in the Face/Nominal Value of the security. Company's Equity Capital remains the same but the shares in issue reduces. Opposite of Sub-Division.

subtypes.description: Reverse Split, currently only used in US events

CONV.name: Conversion
CONV.description: Details of individual Conversions of a convertible security (For example: Preference Share, Convertible Bond). Also sometimes used to transmit Voluntary Offers.

fields.name: part_final
fields.description: Indicates if the conversion is Part or Final. Part conversions may be mandatory.

fields.name: amount_converted
fields.description: Total value of the Bonds that were converted.

fields.name: cur_pair
fields.description: Identifies the different currencies involved for the FX rate to be applied - ISO 4217

CTX.name: Certificate Exchange
CTX.description: Physical exchange of existing certificates for another set of certificates. This may be done in case of sub-division, lot change, name change, exchange of one type of security for another type of security.

CURRD.name: Currency Redenomination
CURRD.description: Change in Security's Capital Currency For example: French Franc to Euro. This may also result in a Par Value change.

fields.name: old_currency
fields.description: Old Par Value Currency Code - ISO 4217

fields.name: new_currency
fields.description: New Par Value Currency Code - ISO 4217

DIST.name: Distribution
DIST.description: Issue of **free** shares of Company B to the shareholders of Company A. There is no transfer of operations/assets of Company A to Company B. The shareholder continues to hold shares in both Company A and Company B. Hence, the event is distinct from Demerger or Bonus.

subtypes.description: Spin-Off, currently only used in US events

DIV.name: Dividend
DIV.description: Distribution of a company's profits for a given period to the shareholders in Cash and/or Stock.

subtypes.description: Forward Split, currently only used in US events

fields.name: foreign_ex_date
fields.description: The Date on which the USD Rate to Currency value was taken.

fields.name: ex_date2
fields.description: This is the Ex Date value for Stock component of a Dividend with a Paytype of (B)oth Stock and Cash. The main Ex Date field will be for the cash payment portion of the same record.

fields.name: pay_date2
fields.description: This is the Payment Date value for Stock component of a Dividend with a Paytype of (B)oth Stock and Cash. The main Payment Date field will be for the cash payment portion of the same record.

fields.name: tbaflag
fields.description: The company intends to pay a dividend but the details are yet to be announced.

fields.name: nil_dividend
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: div_rescind
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: approx_flag
fields.description: If dividend is temporarily an approximate value. Expect an update.

fields.name: coupon
fields.description: In countries where coupons are to be submitted to obtain a benefit this field is useful.

fields.name: div_rate
fields.description: Rate of Dividends as a percentage of Par Value.

fields.name: cur_pair
fields.description: Identifies the different currencies involved for the FX rate to be applied - ISO 4217

fields.name: dep_fees
fields.description: Depositary Fees - Applies only to DR dividends

fields.name: usd_rate_to_currency
fields.description: USD Exchange Rate for Dividend Currency

DIVIF.name: Dividend Investment Fund
DIVIF.description: Distribution of a company's profits for a given period to the shareholders in Cash and/or Stock, Interest from interest bearing securities and cash and, where applicable, rental income from property funds.

fields.name: tbaflag
fields.description: The company intends to pay a dividend but the details are yet to be announced.

fields.name: nil_dividend
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: div_rescind
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: group2_gross_div
fields.description: Gross up of Group 2 Net distribution. Group 2 is Non pari passu dividend.

fields.name: equalisation
fields.description: Amount attributable to net realised income that is included in the price of units created or units cancelled by the unit trust fund during the reporting period.

fields.name: franked_percentage
fields.description: Indicates the portion of the distribution that is franked expressed as a percentage.

fields.name: franked_value
fields.description: Indicates the portion of the distribution that is franked expressed as a value.

fields.name: un_fr_non_foreign_p_c_t
fields.description: Indicates the portion of the the non-foreign distribution that is unfranked expressed as a percentage.

fields.name: un_fr_non_foreign_value
fields.description: Indicates the portion of the non-foreign distribution that is unfranked expressed as a value.

fields.name: un_fr_foreign_p_c_t
fields.description: Indicates the portion of the the foreign distribution that is unfranked expressed as a percentage.

fields.name: un_fr_foreign_value
fields.description: Indicates the portion of the foreign distribution that is unfranked expressed as a value.

fields.name: return_of_capital
fields.description: For US. Portion of Dividend that is a Return of Capital distribution

fields.name: under1250_section
fields.description: For US. Portion of Dividend that is a 1250 section distribution

DMRGR.name: Demerger
DMRGR.description: Separation of a portion of company A's operations/assets into Company B. Shareholders of Company A receive free shares of Company B. (AKA Spin-off)

subtypes.description: Spin-Off, currently only used in US events

DRCHG.name: DR Change
DRCHG.description: Changes in the ratio or underlying security of the Depository Receipt.

fields.name: old_deposit_receipt_ratio
fields.description: Number of old DR's held in DR - UN Ratio

fields.name: new_deposit_receipt_ratio
fields.description: Number of new DR's held in DR - UN Ratio

fields.name: old_unit_ratio
fields.description: Number of old Underlying held in DR - UN Ratio

fields.name: new_unit_ratio
fields.description: Number of new Underlying held in DR - UN Ratio

fields.name: old_unit_security_id
fields.description: Internal Security ID for the Old Underlying Security

fields.name: new_unit_security_id
fields.description: Internal Security ID for the New Underlying Security

fields.name: drip_last_date
fields.description: Last Date to opt for DRIP

fields.name: tbaflag
fields.description: The company intends to pay a dividend but the details are yet to be announced.

fields.name: nil_dividend
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

DVST.name: Divestment
DVST.description: One or more Shareholders of a company offering whole or part of its holding to the existing shareholders of company at a price.

fields.name: trading_security_id
fields.description: Security ID of the security that may be created for trading purposes.

ENT.name: Entitlement
ENT.description: Non-renounceable & non-tradable issue of shares. Is the right to purchase new shares at the specific price. The allotment of shares will usually be in the same company.

fields.name: over_subscription
fields.description: A flag to indicate if the shareholders have the option of oversubscribing for the issue.

fields.name: foreign_ex_date
fields.description: Date USD Rate to Currency value was recorded

fields.name: tbaflag
fields.description: The company intends to pay a dividend but the details are yet to be announced.

fields.name: nil_dividend
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: div_rescind
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: franking_credit
fields.description: Corporate Tax Rate for Franking Credit

FSPLT.name: Forward split
FSPLT.description: A bonus, dividend, or subdivision event. Currently only used for US securities.

fields.name: lapsed_premium
fields.description: If the underlying security has a Bonus issue and company decides ADR shares will not have bonus. The company will sell the share on behalf of ADR holders in the market and return the money to ADR holders. So there is no ratio.

FTT.name: Financial Transaction Tax
FTT.description: As per EU directive, list of securities in each country on which FTT would be leviable.

FYCHG.name: Fin. Year Change
FYCHG.description: Change in accounting year-end of the company

ICC.name: Internat. Code Change
ICC.description: A change in any of the international codes in the system. For a security the International codes will be common across countries.

INCHG.name: Incorporation Change
INCHG.description: Change in the Country of Incorporation of the Issuer.

ISCHG.name: Issuer Name Change
ISCHG.description: Change in the name of the Issuer.

fields.name: legal_name
fields.description: Flagged if New Issuer Name is the legal name

LCC.name: Local Code Change
LCC.description: A change to the Localcode/Symbol/Ticker of the Security.

LIQ.name: Liquidation
LIQ.description: A process by which a bankrupt company is sold off as per the Liquidators' guidelines. The shareholders of the company may receive payment from the liquidation proceeds.

fields.name: liquidator
fields.description: Name of the agency appointed for liquidating the assets of the company.

LSTAT.name: List Status Change
LSTAT.description: Change in the Listing Status of a security, namely Suspension, Delisting or Resumption of trading. All securities are assumed to be traded unless the listing status is changed.

MKCHG.name: Market Seg Change
MKCHG.description: Captures the movement of security from one segment to another within an Exchange.

MRGR.name: Merger
MRGR.description: Coming together of two or more companies to form a new company. Shareholders of all the old companies have to exchange their holding for shares of the new company. The original companies cease to exist.

NLIST.name: New Listing
NLIST.description: A new listing is when a security lists on an exchange for the first time.

ODDLT.name: Odd Lot Offer
ODDLT.description: Offer by the Issuer to the shareholder to change their odd lot holdings into round lots. It may entail sale of odd lot shares to the company or a Buy-in of balance amount by the shareholder.

fields.name: buy_in_price
fields.description: The price at which the Shareholder can opt to buy shares from the company to change his odd lot shareholding into round lot.

fields.name: buy_in_flag
fields.description: Indicates if a Buy-in is available.

fields.name: tbaflag
fields.description: The company intends to pay a dividend but the details are yet to be announced.

fields.name: nil_dividend
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

fields.name: div_rescind
fields.description: Real Dividend event but of zero payrate.

PO.name: Purchase Offer
PO.description: Company A has managerial control of Company B. Company A decides to increase its stake in Company B by offering to buy shares from the shareholders of the Company B. Company B will continue to exist.

fields.name: negotiated_price
fields.description: Price at which the purchasing company struck a deal for a large chunk of the free holding,

fields.name: min_percent
fields.description: TOTAL Percentage of the shares outstanding that the purchaser will buy from the shareholders.

fields.name: max_percent
fields.description: TOTAL Percentage of the shares outstanding that the purchaser will buy from the shareholders.

PRCHG.name: Primary Exchange Chg
PRCHG.description: Change in the Primary Exchange of a security.

PRF.name: Preferential Offer
PRF.description: Offer to the shareholders of Company A to buy securities of Company B on a preferential basis. This offer is a reserved portion of a public offer of Company B. Both companies are normally part of the same group.

fields.name: offeree_name
fields.description: Name of the issuer making the offer but the issuer is not available in the Corporate Actions dataset.

PVRD.name: Par Value Redenomination
PVRD.description: Write up or write down of Par Value where shares outstanding remains the same BUT the Equity Capital changes.

RCAP.name: Return of Capital
RCAP.description: The company decides to return a portion of the equity capital in form of cash. It is often a result of Capital Reduction.

REDEM.name: Redemption
REDEM.description: Details of individual redemption of a redeemable security eg. Preference Share, Bond. Also sometimes used to transmit Voluntary Offers.

fields.name: part_final
fields.description: Is the Redemption for this date Part or Final. Part Redemptions may be Mandatory.

fields.name: amount_redeemed
fields.description: The total value of all the bonds redeemed i.e. in Millions. Mutually exclusive from Redemption in %.

fields.name: redemption_percentage
fields.description: Redemption in %. To allow for Redemption of security which is only on % basis.

fields.name: pool_factor
fields.description: The outstanding principal balance divided by the original principal balance with the result expressed as a Float. Useful in calculating redemption and outstanding par value. Introduced to capture this figure whenever its available.

fields.name: price_as_percentage
fields.description: Flag to indicate that the Issue Price has been quoted only in percentages.

fields.name: tender_offeror
fields.description: Name of the Offeror if it is different from the Issuer.

RSPLT.name: Reverse split
RSPLT.description: A consolidation event, currently only used for US securities.

RTS.name: Rights
RTS.description: Rights Issue is an offer to existing shareholders to subscribe to further securities in proportion to their holding, at a fixed price, made by means of the issue of a renounceable letter which may be traded for a period before payment for securities is due. The allotment of shares will usually be in the same company.

fields.name: over_subscription
fields.description: A flag to indicate if the shareholders have the option of oversubscribing for the issue.

fields.name: lapsed_premium
fields.description: If the shareholder does not subscribe to the rights issue the company would pay him this sum.

fields.name: ratio_old_dist
fields.description: Distribution of Rights - Number of old shares held in old - new ratio

fields.name: ratio_new_dist
fields.description: Distribution of Rights - Number of new Rights tradable shares received in old - new ratio

fields.name: ratio_old_exer
fields.description: Exercise of Rights - Number of Rights exercised in old - new ratio

fields.name: ratio_new_exer
fields.description: Exercise of Rights - Number of resultant securities received per Rights exercised in old - new ratio

fields.name: trading_security_id
fields.description: Security ID of the security that may be created for Trading purposes.

fields.name: pp_security_id
fields.description: Poison Pill Rights: This rights behave same as normal rights but they do not trade at all. This rights are normally announced by the company to avoid hostile takeover.

SCSWP.name: Security Swap
SCSWP.description: An exchange of securities of Company A with those of Company B. For example: Hong Kong companies changing to Bermudan companies prior to British handover to China.

SD.name: Subdivision
SD.description: Reduction in the Face/Nominal Value of the security. Company's Equity Capital remains the same but the shares in issue increases. Opposite of Consolidation.

subtypes.description: Forward Split, currently only used in US events

SECRC.name: Security Reclassif.
SECRC.description: Company reclassifying Security A as Security B or exchanging one security for another. Hence, it happens within the company. For example: Bearer Shares to Registered Shares. This event is distinct from Security Swap.

SHOCH.name: SOS Change
SHOCH.description: Changes in number of Shares Outstanding of a company.

fields.name: old_outstanding_date
fields.description: Effective Date for previous SOS change

fields.name: new_outstanding_date
fields.description: Effective Date for current SOS change

SOFF.name: Spin-off
SOFF.description: A distribution or demerger event, currently only used for US securities.

TKOVR.name: Takeover
TKOVR.description: Company A takes over the managerial control of Company B. Both companies may continue to exist. A Takeover may result in Compulsory Acquisition if the country's trigger limit of minimum public shareholding is breached. Compulsory Acquisition turns the Takeover event from Voluntary to Mandatory.

subtypes.description: Insufficient data to assign a TKOVR event subtype

fields.name: pre_offer_qty
fields.description: Number of shares held by the Offeror prior to making the Takeover offer.

fields.name: pre_offer_percentage
fields.description: Percentage of the Company's shares outstanding that the Offeror held prior to making the Takeover offer

fields.name: target_qty
fields.description: Total Quantity of shares targeted for the Takeover by the Offeror.

fields.name: target_percentage
fields.description: Percentage of the Company's shares outstanding targeted by the Offeror.

fields.name: offeror_name
fields.description: Name of the issuer making the offer but the issuer is not available in the Corporate Actions dataset.

WAREX.name: Exercise of Warrants
WAREX.description: A Warrant normally has tenure, and this tenure could result in redemption or expire: this event describes the exercise terms.
